title: A trip to Australia 澳大利亚之行
description: Mike shows Scott a photograph he took during his trip to Australia. The people in the photograph are people Mike met during the trip. That's the ship they travelled on. That's the man who offered him a job in Australia. And the man with the beard is Mike himself — he grew a beard during the trip but shaved it off when he came home because his wife didn't like it. The lesson introduces relative clauses with the relative pronoun omitted, and the words during, trip, travel, offer, job, guess, grow and beard.
answer_note: The listening comprehension question is a model answer (suggested). Workbook A (Comprehension) is partially in the workbook answer key: items 1-2 are from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-118-123.jpg p.214), items 3-7 are model answers (suggested, marked 'Expected answers' in the key). Workbook B (Vocabulary) is from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-123-129.jpg p.215). Grammar I (combine with relative pronoun omitted) and II (combine according to examples) are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.558-559).

lesson.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question. Who is the man with the beard? 听录音，然后回答问题。那个长着络腮胡子的男人是谁？
lesson.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。那个长着络腮胡子的男人是谁？

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: Look, Scott. This is a photograph I took during my trip to Australia.
lines.translation: 看，斯科特。这是我到澳大利亚旅行时拍的一张照片。

lines.speaker: SCOTT
lines.text: This is a good photograph. Who are these people?
lines.translation: 这是一张很好的照片。这些是谁？

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: They're people I met during the trip.
lines.translation: 他们是我旅行时认识的人。

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: That's the ship we travelled on.

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: That's the man I told you about. Remember?
lines.translation: 这就是我跟你说的那个人。记得吗？

lines.speaker: SCOTT
lines.text: Ah yes. The one who offered you a job in Australia.
lines.translation: 啊，记得。就是在澳大利亚给你找工作的那个人。

lines.speaker: MIKE
lines.text: I grew a beard during the trip, but I shaved it off when I came home.
lines.translation: 我在旅行时留了胡子，但我回到家时把它刮掉了。

lines.speaker: SCOTT
lines.text: Why did you shave it off?

lesson.title: Who is the man with the beard?
lesson.instruction: Answer the question. 回答这个问题。
lesson.context: Comprehension question about who the man with the beard is in the photograph.

questions.prompt: Who is the man with the beard?
questions.answer: It's Mike. He grew a beard during the trip but shaved it off when he came home because his wife didn't like it.

items.title: 1. This is a photograph I took ...
items.text: 这句话中的 I took during my trip to Australia 是一个定语从句，用来修饰 a photograph。由于所修饰的名词在从句中作动词 took 的宾语，因此，引导从句的关系代词 that 往往省略。

items.title: 2. They're people I met during the trip.
items.text: 与注 1 的情况相同，关系代词 whom 往往省略。

practice.title: Practice A: Comprehension
practice.instruction: Look at the dialogue on Students' Book page 249 and answer these questions. 看第 249 页上的对话，然后回答以下问题。
practice.translation: 看第 249 页上的对话，然后回答以下问题。
practice.context: Workbook L123 A: comprehension questions about the Mike/Scott dialogue. Items 1-2 are from the workbook answer key (img/key-118-123.jpg p.214), items 3-7 are model answers (suggested).

questions.prompt: Mike shows Scott a photograph. Is it a photograph he took during his trip to New York?
questions.answer: No, it's a photograph he took during his trip to Australia.

questions.prompt: Who are the people in the photograph?
questions.answer: They are people he met during the trip.

questions.prompt: He shows him another photo. Which ship is it?
questions.answer: It's the ship they travelled on.

questions.prompt: There's another photo of a man smoking a cigar. Who's he?
questions.answer: He's the man who offered him a job in Australia.

questions.prompt: What did Mike grow during the trip?
questions.answer: He grew a beard.

questions.prompt: What did he do with it when he came home?
questions.answer: He shaved it off.

questions.prompt: Why did he shave it off?
questions.answer: Because his wife didn't like it.

practice.title: Practice B: Vocabulary
practice.instruction: Choose and write in the correct word or words. 选词填空。
practice.context: Workbook L123 B: choose and write in the correct word or words.

questions.prompt: The man that I talked to ___ me a very good job. (said / offered)
questions.answer: offered

questions.prompt: Last month I went on a long ___ to America. (travel / trip)
questions.answer: trip

questions.prompt: My big brother always ___ a beard in winter. (grows / makes)
questions.answer: grows

questions.prompt: A shop assistant ___ behind the counter in a shop. (serves / serves on)
questions.answer: serves

questions.prompt: It was very dark so we ___ the torch. (got on / turned on)
questions.answer: turned on

questions.prompt: 'You must remember,' the shop manager told the girls in the shop. 'The ___ is always right.' (customer / assistant)
questions.answer: customer

questions.prompt: 'That was me in that photo — with a beard,' said Mike. 'Didn't you ___ me?' (remember / recognize)
questions.answer: recognize

grammar.title: Grammar I: Combine each pair of sentences according to the example (relative pronoun omitted)
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句把下列每组两个句子合并为一个句子（省略关系代词）。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句把下列每组两个句子合并为一个句子（省略关系代词）。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.558-559 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 10 combine items where the relative pronoun is omitted because it is the object in the relative clause; item 1 is the printed example.

questions.prompt: These are the boxes. We keep the papers in the boxes.
questions.answer: These are the boxes we keep the papers in.

questions.prompt: The chair broke. He was sitting on the chair.
questions.answer: The chair he was sitting on broke.

questions.prompt: Show me the book. You got the book from the library.
questions.answer: Show me the book you got from the library.

questions.prompt: The books are on the top shelf. You were looking for the books.
questions.answer: The books you were looking for are on the top shelf.

questions.prompt: The fruit is very fresh. I bought the fruit in that greengrocer's.
questions.answer: The fruit I bought in that greengrocer's is fresh.

questions.prompt: The knife slipped and cut his hand. He was using the knife.
questions.answer: The knife he was using slipped and cut his hand.

questions.prompt: The window was still open. The thief had climbed through the window.
questions.answer: The window the thief had climbed through was still open.

questions.prompt: The furniture was very dusty. She was cleaning the furniture.
questions.answer: The furniture she was cleaning was very dusty.

questions.prompt: The dress was green. She put on the dress.
questions.answer: The dress she put on was green.

questions.prompt: The book was very interesting. He read the book last week.
questions.answer: The book he read last week was very interesting.

grammar.title: Grammar II: Combine the sentences according to the examples (relative clauses)
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句把下列每组两个句子合并为一个句子。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句把下列每组两个句子合并为一个句子。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.559 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 10 combine items forming relative clauses with who/whom/which/that or omitted; items 1-2 are the printed examples.

questions.prompt: I know the policeman. He is speaking to John.
questions.answer: I know the policeman who is speaking to John.

questions.prompt: I greeted the girl. She goes to my school.
questions.answer: The girl I greeted goes to my school.

questions.prompt: The tourists are from Japan. The tourists have already left.
questions.answer: The tourists who are from Japan have already left.

questions.prompt: That is the lady. I saw her on television last night.
questions.answer: That is the lady I saw on television last night.

questions.prompt: The man was very old. I helped the man.
questions.answer: The man I helped was very old.

questions.prompt: The man is sitting in that car. The man is my boss.
questions.answer: The man who is sitting in that car is my boss.

questions.prompt: The person knows my teacher. I met the person in Beijing.
questions.answer: The person I met in Beijing knows my teacher.

questions.prompt: The man is coming towards us. You are looking for the man.
questions.answer: The man you are looking for is coming towards us.

questions.prompt: The man came to thank you. You helped the man.
questions.answer: The man you helped came to thank you.

questions.prompt: The man is going into that building. We want to see the man.
questions.answer: The man we want to see is going into that building.
